name: DARwIn-OP
summary: An open-platform miniature humanoid (Dynamic Anthropomorphic Robot with Intelligence – Open Platform) developed by ROBOTIS with Virginia Tech's RoMeLa and the University of Pennsylvania. The full mechanical design, electronics and software are open, and it is sold as a kit; it became a common RoboCup and teaching platform and the basis of later ROBOTIS OP models.
notable: Open-source hardware and software, sold commercially
Widely used in RoboCup's kid-size humanoid league
